title: Upgrade from v1 leaves reserved user source rule types disabled
reproduction: Migrate a v1 saved redirect and disabled external source through 1->6.
expected: The reserved user source enables allow and redirect; external defaults and rule identity survive.
observed: Before: user flags 0,0 because 1->2 already wrote the modern URL. After: 1,1; external 0,0.
fix: Update reserved source 1 at 5->6 rather than matching only its former URL.
test_evidence: Extracted SQL v1 fixture passed; actual JDBC chains and v4 probes passed; narrow Room test compiled. Prior combined API34 run: 80/80 passed (owner-reported).

title: Uncached root cursor can pick a noncanonical redirect
reproduction: Stream conflicting same-source redirects before materialization; vary insert order, user and external sources.
expected: First redirect for each host matches canonical runtime choice.
observed: Descending insertion yielded 9.9.9.9 rather than 1.1.1.1 on both scans.
fix: Order the user and source scans by canonical address within source priority.
test_evidence: Host regression red/green; compiled Room cursor regression and retained prior copied-stage tests. Prior combined API34 run: 80/80 passed (owner-reported).

title: Underscores in allow rules also match unrelated hostnames
reproduction: Seed literal, wildcard and suffix underscore allows plus blocked lookalikes. Compare runtime and root rows.
expected: An underscore represents only itself; real wildcards retain their semantics.
observed: Three lookalikes resolved allowed and disappeared from fallback export before patch.
fix: Escape literals in SQL LIKE and apply consistent pattern rules during 14->15 cache population.
test_evidence: Five host root tests green; seeded v14 migration retained exactly five expected rows. Android tests compiled. Prior combined API34 run: 80/80 passed (owner-reported).

title: A host rule explanation can combine mutually exclusive generations
reproduction: Flip active generation and clean stale rows between exact and suffix SELECTs.
expected: A single explanation reads one committed database snapshot.
observed: Old exact row plus new suffix row (1,2); transaction control returned (1,1) for both methods.
fix: Use a Room transaction around each composed host-list read.
test_evidence: Two-connection WAL probe; generated Room wrapper inspection and Android callback test compilation. No Android execution. Prior combined API34 run: 80/80 passed (owner-reported).

title: Checker shows unknown for a domain explicitly allowed by a wildcard
reproduction: Check a child matching an enabled user or downloaded wildcard; compare with a truly unknown hostname and a higher-priority exact redirect.
expected: Show matched allow origins without overriding runtime status; offer Block only for UNKNOWN and Remove only for an exact user exception.
observed: Runtime allow probe returned 1; no matching explanation row, so caller chooses UNKNOWN.
fix: Share the existing active allow predicate; project source ID, host and kind separately from exact-only removal. Use actual root/VPN resolver and gate Fragment actions by status.
test_evidence: Two new host SQL checks, five existing SQL checks and 19 checker JVM tests passed; generated packet allow SQL unchanged. API34 80/80 predates PB-DATA-005; new instrumentation cases compiled, not run.
